title: SouthStar Charters NJ / NY
blurb: Guests experience private luxury yacht tours of NYC Harbor including views of the Statue of Liberty and Manhattan skyline, or fishing charters along the New Jersey coast. Trips are year-round with climate-controlled cabins. Charters are customizable for families, groups, and corporate events.
extraNote: Harbor tours depart from Staten Island, NY. Fishing and dive charters depart from Bayview Harbor or Light House Marina in Barnegat Light, NJ; Atlantis Marina in Staten Island, NY; or the Shark River in Belmar, NJ, depending on the trip. · Year-round
